title: Plaza de la Constitución protest against the 2021 budget and Giammattei government
location: Plaza de la Constitución, in front of the National Palace of Culture, Guatemala City
organizer: Broad civic gathering; article does not identify a single organizer; artists, social organizations and collectives among those cited
participants_original: Hundreds from early morning; several hundred in the plaza by 15:30, per Prensa Libre
threshold_50_evidence: Prensa Libre explicitly describes hundreds at the Plaza gathering and several hundred at 15:30, exceeding 50 qualitatively.

start_date.summary: The report explicitly dates the gathering to Saturday 21 November 2020.

location.summary: A several-hundred-person peaceful gathering at Plaza de la Constitución in front of the National Palace of Culture, Guatemala City.

demands.summary: Opposition to the 2021 budget approved by Congress, its distribution/cuts, and chants against President Giammattei and the supporting congressional bloc.

participants.summary: Hundreds from early in the day; several hundred at 15:30, per the article.

threshold_50.summary: Plural hundreds at one named gathering; separate from the smaller group that attacked Congress and from uncounted departmental events.

notes: This event is the central Plaza gathering; do not merge the smaller violent group at Congress or department-specific gatherings without direct linkage. The wider late-November and December episode is unresolved.
open_questions: Was this gathering a single day or part of a continuing action beyond 21 Nov?
What was the relation to the 28 Nov demonstrations and Dec 10 gathering?
Separate provincial events need individual attendance evidence and episode ownership.

title: Quetzaltenango central park demonstration against the 2021 budget and government corruption
location: March from CUNOC through central Quetzaltenango streets to Parque Central, Quetzaltenango department
organizer: Several university/social collectives; one local organizer read a statement endorsed by organizations from Quetzaltenango and Totonicapán
participants_original: More than 3,000 people walked and hundreds gathered in the park, according to Prensa Comunitaria
threshold_50_evidence: The local report states >3,000 walked and hundreds assembled at the named central park gathering; at least 50 is clearly supported qualitatively.

start_date.summary: The report identifies the gathering as Saturday 21 November 2020.

location.summary: March from CUNOC to central park in Quetzaltenango; hundreds at the park.

demands.summary: Against 2021 budget approval and government corruption; calls for President/deputy resignations and dissolution of Centro de Gobierno.

participants.summary: More than 3,000 walked; hundreds at central park according to local report.

threshold_50.summary: Hundreds at one named gathering, over the threshold.

state_response.summary: At the end, after most protesters left, a smaller group confronted police; tear gas used and six people arrested. Do not characterize entire crowd as violent.

notes: Keep separate from Guatemala City Plaza gathering and other departmental demonstrations. The article’s one-source estimate supports threshold but needs independent review; the end confrontation involved only a smaller remaining group.
open_questions: Did the Quetzaltenango protest recur on 28 Nov or later dates?
Could another local source independently report this specific attendance?
Can event episode end date be established without conflating nearby city or national actions?

title: #28N mass gathering in Plaza de la Constitución against the 2021 budget and Giammattei government
location: Plaza de la Constitución, zone 1, Guatemala City
organizer: National #28N civic call; participating student groups, Indigenous leaders and families; no single organizer identified
participants_original: Thousands arrived, according to Prensa Libre
threshold_50_evidence: Prensa Libre reports thousands at one named plaza gathering; qualifies clearly over 50 without pooling provincial sites.

start_date.summary: Article explicitly dates #28N and the Plaza gathering to 28 November 2020.

location.summary: Thousands at Plaza de la Constitución, zone 1, Guatemala City.

demands.summary: Against the 2021 budget and government; calls for resignations of president/deputies, closure of Centro de Gobierno and a constituent assembly.

participants.summary: Thousands reported in the Plaza; provincial sites are separate and uncounted.

threshold_50.summary: Qualitative “thousands” at a single named gathering.

notes: Treat as a distinct dated mass gathering in the wider budget protest wave; do not merge the separate group of about ten who burned a bus or any provincial events. Relationship to Nov21/Dec events remains unresolved.
open_questions: Was #28N a distinct protest or continuation of the 21 Nov episode under the MM episode rule?
Any separate provincial gatherings with their own >=50 evidence?
What is the wave’s final end date?
